newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-H.Smith sees fairly steady 1st half.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-H.Smith sees fairly steady 1st half.

text.p: Engineering and hardware group Howard Smith Ltd said on Wednesday it did not expect its profit for the first half to be greatly up on the first half results a year ago.
"The half year is going to be satisfactory under the circumstances, but I don't expect it to be greatly up on last year's first half," managing director Ken Moss told reporters.

Moss said this followed the company's withdrawal from shipping, which meant earnings before interest and tax from this division would fall to A$2 million in 1996/97 year from A$12 million in the 1995/96 year.

Moss said the company had to make up the shortfall over the full year, repeating that the group expected the full year's results to be above last year, but the first half was "line ball" with the previous half.
The company announced a 1995/96 full year net profit of A$86.13 million in August and said it expected to improve its pre-abnormal profit for the year to June 30, 1997.
